To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the SAGE algorithm is an attractive method for sequence estimation problems, especially when the signal can be represented by a discrete wavelet transform, and that the SAGE method can be extended to multiple user systems.
the SAGE algorithm is a computationally efficient method for joint estimation, and that it can be implemented using a wavelet decomposition of data.
a maximum likelihood receiver for a single user CDMA communication system can be designed using the EM algorithm, and a discrete wavelet transform is useful in the design of such a system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel application of the EM algorithm to the joint estimation of the amplitude, phase, and time delay of a single-user CDMA signal.
the application of the EM and SAGE algorithms for the estimation of the parameters of a single user CDMA system.
the development of a computationally efficient ML sequence estimator for a direct sequence spread spectrum system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper is well organized and well written.
this is a promising algorithm which is computationally efficient, and has the potential for achieving near optimal performance in the single user case.
this algorithm is computationally efficient, has a fast convergence and essentially achieves optimal detection performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a computationally efficient maximum likelihood receiver for CDMA systems.
the proposed algorithm can be implemented as a real-time receiver, and can achieve the performance of the optimal ML sequence estimator.
we developed an algorithm for joint estimation of the parameters of the received signal.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EM algorithm can be used for joint estimation in a CDMA receiver with good performance, and the use of a wavelet decomposition can simplify the estimation problem considerably.
the SAGE algorithm can be successfully used for sequence estimation in spread spectrum systems.
the SAGE algorithm, in combination with a wavelet decomposition, can be used to develop computationally efficient ML receivers for CDMA systems.
